question: Why did APAC's completed revenue fall so much more than other regions' from Q2 to Q3 2025?
plan: The user asks why APAC's completed revenue fell more than other regions, but the query only shows the revenue figures without explaining the underlying causes.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.category, p.product_name, r.region_name, SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS order_month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' GROUP BY r.region_name, p.category, p.product_name, SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7) ORDER BY r.region_name, revenue DESC LIMIT 500

answer: APAC's completed revenue fell from Q2 to Q3 2025 primarily due to a sharp drop in Hardware revenue, which went from 572,289.54 in Q2 down to 142,696.82 in Q3. Software also decreased from 120,267.21 to 98,632.21, Services from 141,015.21 to 136,587.27, and Accessories from 19,136.88 to 16,394.69.
